definitions.gloss: see you later, take care (farewell to someone leaving)
definitions.explanation: A set phrase said to someone who is leaving. It is the standard response to {行|い}ってきます. Literally means 'go and come back (please).'

examples.english: See you later! / Have a good day!

examples.japanese: 「⟦{行|い}ってきます→行ってきます：01029_ittekimasu⟧」「{行|い}ってらっしゃい」
⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧、{行|い}ってらっしゃい。
examples.english: Take care, have a good day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{行|い}ってらっしゃい、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}います→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Every morning, my mother says to me as I leave home, 'See you later, do your best today.'

notes:
{行|い}ってらっしゃい is said to someone leaving, expressing a wish for them to go safely and return.

USAGE:
This is the standard response to ⟦{行|い}ってきます→行ってきます：01029_ittekimasu⟧. It literally means 'please go and come back.'

FORMS:
- {行|い}ってらっしゃい: standard polite
- {行|い}ってらっしゃいませ: very polite (formal contexts, service staff)

COMMON ADDITIONS:
- ⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧{行|い}ってらっしゃい: take care on your way
- {行|い}ってらっしゃい、⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: have a good day, do your best

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}ってきます→行ってきます：01029_ittekimasu⟧: I'm leaving (said by the one departing)
- ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧: I'm home (upon returning)
- ⟦お{帰|かえ}りなさい→お帰りなさい：01042_okaerinasai⟧: welcome back (response to ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧)
